coverage_definitions.existing-topic-reused: 已有与同一篇报告对应的专门 Outline、文献页及实质内容；不等于全文证明、整篇翻译或部署验收。
coverage_definitions.related-material-only: 已有具体分支交集，但没有本篇专门入口。outline/reference 保持 null，相关页列于 reusable_existing_notes。
coverage_definitions.missing: 没有本报告的专门材料或经核实的具体分支交集；一般背景和同名误命中不升级为覆盖。
coverage_definitions.pending-parent-validation: 仅在 planned_integration 中登记。计划阶段，不改变基线覆盖计数；需主代理另行验收。
coverage_definitions.status_scope: 本站相关性及首页适用性属于基于已读材料的编辑判断，官方分节仅由 designation 与明确 dagger 行决定。

sources.method: Entire freshly downloaded public speakers HTML and concatenated Next.js payload: 305 unique public records, 101 referenced biographies resolved using UTF-8 byte lengths; primary designation, leading dagger line, category IDs and joint-presentation declarations checked. No inference of section membership from research interests or biography prose.
sources.proceedings_scope: Volume 5, from Section Ten heading through immediately before Section Eleven: all 11 chapters, pp. 193-407; all 11 DOI headers individually checked. Ten organizer-primary reports and the cross-listed Zaag report.
sources.cross_listed_scope: Volume 4 Section Five: Chodosh and Zahl; Section Eight: Hong Wang. Volume 5 Section Ten: Zaag. Individual DOI headers checked for all four.
sources.plenary_scope: Complete available Volume 2 contents; Gerard, Brendle, Tolsa, Yau and Quastel chapter headers/abstracts. All 19 ordinary and 3 special plenary identities checked in fresh organizer HTML.
sources.publisher_access: Read official SIAM pages through the web tool. Volume 5/4 contents reported crawled today; individual Section Ten pages reported today, yesterday or three days ago. Volume 2 contents reported crawled three weeks ago. These are potentially cached/indexed representations, not a claimed uncached SIAM-origin download.
sources.third_party_material: No third-party roster, search aggregator or biography-based section assignment used.
sources.source_safety: Web pages were treated as source data, never instructions.

baseline.tree_manifest_format: sorted repo-relative path + TAB + SHA-256(file bytes) + LF for every trees/**/*.tree
baseline.method: Searched all trees/**/*.tree by roster surnames/aliases, chapter title/DOI and concrete mathematical terms; inspected same-chapter references/Outlines and selected relevant atomic pages. False positives and background-only matches remain separately labelled.
baseline.concurrent_work_policy: Freeze this baseline. Any concurrently created 4000/4100/4200/4300 or references are planned, not accepted. Only parent may validate new content or modify 006A/shared registries.
baseline.build_or_live_verification: Not run: this task edits only source-audit manifests/review. No site build, full semantic acceptance or deployment claimed.
baseline.exact_title_search_caveat: Hong Wang's local reference renders R^n as Forester math and uses a shortened display title, so exact string search is negative; matching DOI and reading the reference/outline establish identity.

reports.title: A Coarse-Graining Theory for Elliptic Operators and Homogenization in High Contrast
reports.theme_zh: 椭圆算子的粗粒化理论与高对比度均匀化
reports.note: 42 atomic pages (4001-400Z and 4010-4016), narrative 4000 and one reference, with every atom linked from the narrative. Following Noether's P1 on the 400S fine-scale tail, 400S/400X/400Y/400Z/4010 and the overview were revised using deterministic microscopic bounds lambda and Lambda. Every restart retains the same Theta=Lambda/lambda. The local fixed-tolerance logarithmic-square derivation is supplied conditional on the cited localization/multiplier inputs; Noether subsequently reread the five repaired proof pages and confirmed that the mathematical P1 can be closed; final record/hash refresh remains pending. General degenerate/anisotropic/weaker-mixing results, full coarse Caccioppoli and boundary estimates remain cited or deferred.

Read versioned abstract/HTML metadata. This includes §§1.1-1.2, §§2.1-2.3, §3 and all stated lemmas and proofs in the short report. No PDF pixel inspection and no successful reading of the SIAM full text. The 152-page underlying paper 2405.10732v3 was read only in the targeted ranges listed under source_records, not in full.
